verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT authentication and regional endpoints, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The model release numbers (2.6, 3.0 Omni) are model versions, not a versioned API contract with documented deprecation terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
